prepSteps.title: Create an Entro auth method in Akeyless
prepSteps.instruction: In Akeyless, create a Universal Identity or API Key auth method named for Entro and note Access ID (and UID if Universal Identity).
prepSteps.evidence: Akeyless lists the Entro auth method with an Access ID

typedActions.prepStepTitle: Create an Entro auth method in Akeyless
typedActions.mutation: akeyless create-auth-method or create-auth-method-universal-identity named for Entro; operator stores Access Key / UID outside the session
typedActions.expectedChange: Akeyless lists the Entro auth method with an Access ID
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: Delete the auth method created this run
